headings: Data Center Sourcing, Development and Operation
paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this Annual Report to the "Company," "Cipher," "Cipher Digital," "we," "us" or "our" refers to Cipher Digital Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, unless otherwise indicated.

We are dedicated to developing and operating industrial-scale data centers engineered for next-generation computing at the highest standards of innovation, precision, and excellence. Over the past several years, we have intentionally evolved from a pure-play bitcoin miner into a vertically integrated data center development and operations platform focused on energy-intensive compute infrastructure. Our vertical integration spans critical stages of the data center value chain, including land and power origination and interconnection, site development, data center design and construction, oversight and ongoing facility operations.

Fundamentally, we bring together construction, engineering, operations, power, real estate and technology expertise to deliver high quality, purpose-built data centers that meet tenants' needs. Our in-house teams source and control industrial-scale sites with access to substantial electric power capacity, advance grid interconnection and substation development, and manage the design and construction of data center campuses. We also operate and maintain energy-intensive data center facilities, leveraging operational expertise developed through our employees' extensive experience managing Tier III HPC data centers and large, flexible electrical loads. Against a backdrop of increasing demand for artificial intelligence ("AI") technology and access to energized HPC data centers to meet consumers' demands for such technology, we believe we play an important part of the AI economy and we expect to benefit from powerful, long-term growth drivers.

While bitcoin mining has been an important component of our business model in prior years, our strategy increasingly emphasizes the development of industrial-scale data centers that can be leased to hyperscalers and other HPC customers under long-term contracts, while retaining the flexibility to deploy bitcoin mining as an interim or complementary use of power.

On February 20, 2026, we changed our name to "Cipher Digital Inc." Rebranding to "Cipher Digital" aligns with our corporate strategy to scale into a leading HPC data center developer and operator, as we leverage our existing site pipeline and source additional sites, partnering with premier tenants, and developing and operating industry-leading data centers purpose-built for HPC. Our goal is to monetize our power assets and manage capital efficiently through market cycles in order to align our infrastructure with the growing global demand for AI-driven compute capacity.

Our data center portfolio consists of 4.2 gigawatts ("GW") of capacity across 10 sites, at various stages of interconnection. We are currently developing 600 megawatts ("MW") of HPC data center facilities across two sites for hyperscaler tenants, and we currently operate approximately 207 MW of power at one bitcoin mining data center in Texas. We also maintain a pipeline of approximately 3.4 GW across seven sites in Texas and one additional site in Ohio.

We believe we have secured key HPC leases for our data centers and expect to continue to do so for the additional sites in our portfolio due to several key strengths and strategies. We believe we have a demonstrated ability to source high-quality sites suitable for HPC tenants, with characteristics like proximity to major metropolitan areas, ample acreage, diverse fiber routes, and available interconnection infrastructure. We have experienced in-house construction, engineering and operations teams and project management competencies. We have demonstrated an ability to access and manage capital in a disciplined manner.

A significant component of our current and future growth is expected to be generated through the development of our existing portfolio and acquisition of new sites. We are focused on developing the remaining sites in our pipeline for future HPC tenants, and evaluating additional sites, locations, and partnerships to expand our pipeline that are suitable for HPC tenants. From time to time, we may also look to sell individual assets that we do not consider to be core to our business and growth strategy. For further details on our pipeline of future sites that we expect to be suitable for HPC, see "—Site Pipeline."

In 2025, we entered into two leases with HPC tenants. As a result of these developments, our HPC-related contracts represent a significant portion of our expected future revenues. Additionally, we acquired two sites in 2025 that expanded our total development pipeline to approximately 3.4 GW of site capacity. The remainder of our portfolio of sites also continues to attract interest from potential HPC tenants and possible leasing opportunities.

In the third quarter of 2025, through our wholly-owned subsidiary Cipher Barber Lake LLC ("Cipher Barber Lake"), we entered into long-term HPC leases with Fluidstack USA II Inc. ("Fluidstack") to construct a data center at our Barber Lake site ("Barber Lake" or the "Barber Lake Facility"), located near Colorado City, Texas, supported by a lease recognition agreement, pursuant to which Google LLC ("Google") has agreed to backstop certain obligations of Fluidstack under our HPC leases with Fluidstack.

The Barber Lake Facility is being constructed on 250 acres of land owned by Cipher Barber Lake, and will have a gross capacity of 300 MW. 244 MW of gross capacity will be allocated to Fluidstack in Barber Lake Phase I, and the remaining 56 MW will be allocated to Fluidstack in Barber Lake Phase II. Cipher Barber Lake has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection without any restrictions on the load profile and has entered into agreements necessary to participate in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas ("ERCOT") market.

Cipher Barber Lake is targeting delivery of Barber Lake Phase I by September 30, 2026, and of Barber Lake Phase II by January 31, 2027. Construction commenced in 2025 and is proceeding under a structured delivery framework emphasizing off-site manufacturing, modular construction, and early procurement of long-lead equipment.

In October 2025, through our wholly-owned subsidiary Cipher Black Pearl LLC ("Cipher Black Pearl"), we entered into a 15-year lease agreement with Amazon Web Services, Inc. ("Amazon") to deliver approximately 300 gross MW of turnkey data center capacity at the site ("Black Pearl" or the "Black Pearl Facility"), with phased delivery expected to commence in 2026.

The Black Pearl Facility is being constructed on approximately 75 acres of land owned by a wholly-owned Cipher subsidiary near Wink, Texas. The Black Pearl Facility has received approvals for 300 MW of interconnection and has entered into agreements necessary to participate in the ERCOT market.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business, Industry and Operations
Our business is exposed to construction risks.
Our HPC business strategy may not perform as planned.
Our business depends upon the demand for data centers.

Constructing data centers for HPC hosting requires significant capital expenditures, and we may be unable to secure capital or financing for our construction efforts to develop data centers for HPC hosting.
Enhanced tariff, import/export restrictions, or other trade barriers may have an adverse impact on global economic conditions.
We may be harmed by increased costs to procure power, prolonged power outages, shortages or capacity constraints as well as insufficient access to power.
Any failure of our physical or information technology or operational technology infrastructure or services could lead to significant costs and disruptions.
We depend on tenants for our HPC data centers.
Our business has significant tenant concentration.
Our contracts with HPC data center tenants could subject us to significant liability.
Our business has grown rapidly and we have an evolving business model and strategy, which includes our diversification into constructing and operating data centers for HPC companies.
Operating HPC data centers is energy-intensive, which may have a negative environmental impact. Changing environmental regulation and public energy policy may expose our business to new risks.

We have concentrated our operations and, thus, are particularly exposed to the performance of our data centers located in Texas and changes in the regulatory environment, market conditions and natural disasters in Texas.
We may be affected by price fluctuations in the wholesale and retail power markets.
Bitcoin miners and other necessary hardware are subject to malfunction, technological obsolescence and physical degradation.
The price of bitcoin has historically been subject to wide swings, and our operating results may be adversely affected by our hedging activity.
We may experience difficulties in effectively managing our growth and expanding our operations.
If we fail to maintain and enhance our brand and reputation, our business, operating results and financial condition may be adversely affected.
Failure to keep up with evolving trends and shareholder expectations relating to ESG businesses or reporting could adversely impact our reputation, share price and access to and cost of capital.
Our compliance and risk management methods might not be effective and may result in outcomes that could adversely affect our reputation, operating results, and financial condition.
If we are unable to protect the confidentiality of our trade secrets or other intellectual property rights, our business and competitive position could be harmed.
Our limited insurance protection exposes us and our shareholders to the risk of loss of our bitcoin for which no person is liable.
paragraphs: Our business involves significant risks, some of which are described below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report. The realization of any of these risks and uncertainties could have a material adverse effect on our reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, growth and future prospects as well as our ability to accomplish our strategic objectives. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this Annual Report to the "Company," "Cipher," "Cipher Digital," "we," "us" or "our" refers to Cipher Digital Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, unless otherwise indicated.

If we are unable to complete the construction of our HPC data centers in a timely manner or within our anticipated cost estimates, it could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, liquidity and our ability to make payments on our outstanding indebtedness.

Our business depends upon the construction of data centers for our HPC tenants. Until we complete construction of those data centers, we will not realize the full amount of projected revenue from such leases. We cannot guarantee we will complete construction of all or any portion of the Barber Lake Facility, the Black Pearl Facility, or any future strategic growth initiatives on time or within our cost estimates, if at all, due in part to the ongoing challenges to the global supply chain, the implementation of new tariffs and more restrictive trade policies, increased inflation and changing conditions within the United States labor market.

Under certain circumstances, our lessees will have the right to terminate the lease if there are significant delays in the completion of construction, subject to extension for force majeure events and certain tenant delays. If we experience delays in the construction process or are unable to complete construction within our anticipated costs estimates, we may not generate sufficient revenues to fund our liquidity needs, including payment of principal and interest on the notes.

Development and construction delays, cost overruns, changes in market circumstances, environmental or community constraints, and other factors may have a material adverse effect on our operations, expansion plans, financial position and financial performance.

headings: 資料中心採購、開發與營運
paragraphs: 除非文意另有所指，本年度報告中提及的「本公司」、「Cipher」、「Cipher Digital」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們的」均指 Cipher Digital Inc. 及其合併子公司，除非另有說明。
我們致力於開發與營運符合次世代計算標準的工業規模資料中心，並以創新、精準與卓越為最高目標。在過去幾年中，我們有意地從純粹的比特幣礦場經營者，轉型為整合垂直的資料中心開發與營運平台，專注於高能耗計算基礎設施。我們的垂直整合涵蓋資料中心價值鏈中的關鍵階段，包括土地與電力來源及連線、場地開發、資料中心設計與建設，以及設施的監督與持續營運。

從根本而言，我們結合了建設、工程、營運、電力、不動產與科技專業，以提供符合租戶需求的高品質、專為用途設計的資料中心。我們的內部團隊會尋找並控制具備大量電力容量的工業規模場地，進而推動電網連線與變電站開發，並管理資料中心園區的設計與建設。我們也營運並維護高能耗的資料中心設施，透過員工在管理第三級 HPC 資料中心與大型靈活電力負載方面的豐富經驗，來提升營運專業能力。在人工智慧（"AI"）技術需求不斷增加，以及對具備電力的 HPC 資料中心需求日益成長的背景下，我們相信我們在 AI 經濟中扮演重要角色，並預期能從強大且長遠的成長動力中受益。
雖然比特幣礦場在過去幾年是我們商業模式的重要組成部分，但我們的策略越來越側重於開發可出租給超大型企業（hyperscalers）及其他 HPC 客戶的工業規模資料中心，並透過長期合約進行營運，同時保留將比特幣礦場作為臨時或補充用途的靈活性。

我們於 2026 年 2 月 20 日將公司名稱更名為 "Cipher Digital Inc."。重新品牌為 "Cipher Digital" 與我們的企業戰略一致，即朝向成為領先的 HPC 資料中心開發與營運商發展，我們將利用現有的場地管道並尋求更多場地，與頂級租戶合作，並開發與營運專為 HPC 設計的行業領先資料中心。我們的目標是透過市場週期來實現電力資產的價值，並有效管理資本，以符合全球對 AI 驅動計算能力日益增長的需求。
我們的資料中心組合包含 4.2 億瓦（"GW"）的容量，分佈在 10 個場地，處於不同階段的連線狀態。我們目前正在開發兩處場地的 600 兆瓦（"MW"）HPC 資料中心設施，用以服務超大型企業租戶，同時我們目前在德克薩斯州的一個比特幣礦場運營約 207 兆瓦的電力。我們也維護一個約 3.4 億瓦的場地管道，分佈在德克薩斯州的七處場地，以及一處位於俄亥俄州的場地。
我們相信我們已取得關鍵的 HPC 租約，並預期會持續取得我們組閤中其他場地的租約，這是因為我們具備多項關鍵優勢與策略。我們相信我們已展現出尋找適合 HPC 租戶的高品質場地的能力，這些場地具備如靠近主要都會區、廣闊的用地、多樣化的光纖路線，以及可用的連線基礎設施等特點。我們擁有具備經驗的內部建設、工程與營運團隊，以及專案管理能力。我們已展現出以紀律方式取得並管理資金的能力。
我們目前與未來成長的重要組成部分，預期將來自於現有組合的開發與新場地的取得。我們專注於開發我們管道中尚未完成的場地，以服務未來的 HPC 租戶，並評估其他場地、地點與合作夥伴，以擴展我們的管道，使其適合 HPC 租戶。有時我們也可能考慮出售那些我們認為不屬於我們業務與成長策略核心的個別資產。有關我們預期適合 HPC 的未來場地管道的更多細節，請參閱 "—場地管道"。
2025年，本公司與HPC租戶簽訂了兩份租賃契約。基於這些發展，本公司與HPC相關的契約佔預期未來營業收入的相當大比例。此外，本公司於2025年取得兩處地點，使總開發管道擴充至約3.4 GW的場地容量。本公司其他場地的投資組合也持續吸引潛在HPC租戶的興趣及可能的租賃機會。

2025年第三季，透過本公司全資子公司Cipher Barber Lake LLC（"Cipher Barber Lake"），本公司與Fluidstack USA II Inc.（"Fluidstack"）簽訂長期HPC租賃契約，以在Barber Lake場地（"Barber Lake"或"Barber Lake Facility"）興建資料中心，該場地位於德克薩斯州科羅拉多城附近，並透過租賃認可協議支持，根據該協議，Google LLC（"Google"）同意為Fluidstack在與Fluidstack的HPC租賃契約下所負的義務提供擔保。

Barber Lake Facility正在250英畝由Cipher Barber Lake所有的土地上興建，預計總裝置容量為300 MW。Barber Lake第一階段將分配244 MW的總裝置容量給Fluidstack，剩餘的56 MW將分配給Fluidstack在Barber Lake第二階段。Cipher Barber Lake已取得300 MW的連接許可，且無對負載型態的限制，並已與電力可靠性委員會德州（"ERCOT"）市場參與所需的協議。
Cipher Barber Lake預計於2026年9月30日完成Barber Lake第一階段，並於2027年1月31日完成Barber Lake第二階段。興建工作於2025年啟動，並在一個結構化的交付框架下進行，強調離場製造、模組化建設及長週期設備的早期採購。
2025年10月，透過本公司全資子公司Cipher Black Pearl LLC（"Cipher Black Pearl"），本公司與Amazon Web Services, Inc.（"Amazon"）簽訂15年租賃契約，以在場地（"Black Pearl"或"Black Pearl Facility"）提供約300 MW的總裝置容量的交鑰匙資料中心，預計分階段交付於2026年開始。
Black Pearl Facility正在德克薩斯州溫克附近由全資Cipher子公司所有的約75英畝土地上興建。Black Pearl Facility已取得300 MW的連接許可，並已與電力可靠性委員會德州（"ERCOT"）市場參與所需的協議。

headings: 與本公司業務、產業及營運相關之風險
本公司業務面臨建設風險。
本公司HPC業務策略可能無法如預期執行。
本公司業務依賴資料中心之需求。
為HPC hosting建設資料中心需要大量資本支出，本公司可能無法取得資本或融資以支應建設資料中心之努力。
增強性關稅、進出口限制或其他貿易障礙可能對全球經濟條件產生負面影響。
本公司可能因取得電力成本增加、電力中斷時間延長、電力短缺或容量限制，以及電力取得不足而受到損害。
本公司物理基礎設施或資訊科技或營運科技基礎設施或服務若發生故障，可能導致重大成本與中斷。
我們依賴租戶來運營我們的高效能計算（HPC）資料中心。
我們的業務具有顯著的租戶集中度。
我們與HPC資料中心租戶簽訂的合約可能使我們面臨重大賠償責任。
我們的業務成長迅速，且我們的業務模式與策略持續演進，其中包括我們向HPC公司建設與營運資料中心的多元化發展。
運營高效能計算（HPC）資料中心需要大量能源，這可能對環境產生負面影響。環境法規的變動與公共能源政策的改變可能使我們的業務面臨新的風險。
我們的業務集中於特定地區，因此特別受到位於德克薩斯州的資料中心運營表現、德克薩斯州的法規環境、市場條件與自然災害的影響。
我們可能受到電力批發與零售市場價格波動的影響。
比特幣挖礦機與其他必要硬體可能出現故障、技術過時與物理退化。
比特幣的價格歷來波動極大，本公司營運成果可能因避險活動而受到不利影響。
本公司可能面臨有效管理成長與擴展營運的困難。
若本公司無法維持並提升品牌與聲譽，將可能對營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
未能跟上ESG業務或報告相關的趨勢與股東期待，可能對聲譽、股價與取得資金的難易度及成本造成不利影響。
本公司合規與風險管理方法可能無法有效運作，導致結果可能對聲譽、營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
若本公司無法保護商業機密或智慧財產權，將可能對業務與競爭地位造成損害。
本公司有限的保險保障使本公司與股東面臨比特幣遺失的風險，且無人需承擔責任。
paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及重大風險，部分風險已於下文說明。請您謹慎考量下文所述風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中所有其他資訊。任何上述風險與不確定性實現，可能對本公司聲譽、業務、財務狀況、營運成果、成長與未來展望，以及達成戰略目標的能力造成重大不利影響。若發生此等情況，本公司普通股之市價可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
除非文意另有明確要求，本年度報告中提及「本公司」、「Cipher」、「Cipher Digital」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們」，均指 Cipher Digital Inc. 及其合併子公司，除非另有說明。
若本公司無法按時或在預期成本內完成 HPC 資料中心之建設，可能對本公司業務、營運成果、流動性及償還現有債務之能力造成重大不利影響。
本公司業務依賴為 HPC 租戶建設資料中心。在完成這些資料中心建設前，本公司將無法實現預期之租賃收入。本公司無法保證能按時或在預期成本內完成 Barber Lake 設施、Black Pearl 設施或任何未來戰略成長計畫之建設，部分原因在於全球供應鏈持續面臨挑戰、新關稅與更嚴格貿易政策之實施、通貨膨脹增加以及美國勞動市場條件之變動。
在某些情況下，租戶有權因建設完成出現重大延誤而終止租賃，但可因不可抗力事件及租戶延誤而延長。若本公司在建設過程中遭遇延誤，或無法在預期成本內完成建設，本公司可能無法產生足夠收入以支應流動性需求，包括償還票據之本金與利息。
開發與建設延誤、成本超支、市場情況變動、環境或社區限制，以及其他因素，可能對本公司營運、擴張計畫、財務狀況與財務表現造成重大不利影響。
